plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: BIOBRIDGE uses your location to confirm you are inside your branch's geofence when you clock in or out.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: BIOBRIDGE uses your location in the background so you can be clocked in and out automatically when you arrive at, and leave, your branch.

extra._comment: Base URL of the BIOBRIDGE bridge. The login screen can override it at runtime (persisted in the session), so a changed host needs no rebuild.
extra._comment_mobileKey: Must match MOBILE_PUNCH_KEY on the server (default: biobridge-mobile).
extra._comment_handsFree: Automatic arrival/departure clocking via background geofencing. Off = button-only clocking (no background location, no persisted jobs).
extra._comment_cleartext: RELEASE builds need android:usesCleartextTraffic="true" on <application> (set by hand in android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml). Without it Android blocks plain http:// and the app reports 'Cannot reach the bridge'. Re-running `expo prebuild` wipes that line; re-add it.
